outcome_sought: Check how the loan was approved when she could not afford it, and agree a smaller monthly payment.
rationale: She says the branch recorded an income of £2,400 when she told them about £1,400, and the application log shows income verification was waived, so CP-4.2 means both versions are recorded and a person decides. She is in arrears with collections still active, so CP-9.1 and CP-9.2 apply, and her limited English and preference for written contact must be recorded under CP-5.2. The redactor must catch both the accented and plain spellings of her surname. Contact calls in the log failed, so no documented complaint contact attempt exists.
